name: cover-complete-figure-v1
summary: Complete a cut-off uploaded character from head to feet.

steps.name: cover
steps.prompt: Redraw THIS character full body from the top of the head to the feet, standing and facing forward, arms held a little away from the body. Keep the same character, outfit, colours, line style and medium as the upload. Keep everything visible in the upload; complete only what is cut off (legs, feet, boots), consistent with the visible clothing. Plain background.
